{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (e.g., >70.00) by 5–10% in the next 3–5 days.",
    "Adjust downward forecasts when sentiment history includes negative values (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00) — especially if recent prices are trending downward.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 2–5% per day until convergence.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history shows 0.00 for 3+ consecutive days — may indicate market cooling.",
    "For forecasts with high volatility (>10% deviation from true outcome), apply smoothing: reduce peak values by 5–10% and adjust tail risk downward.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., >5% under for 3+ days), reduce forecast by 2–5% per day to align with mean reversion.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.50, reduce forecast by 3–5% to reflect potential market pessimism or regulatory pressure."
  ]
}
